title: Easy Elegant American Pork Skillet
description: A citrusy and aerated American dish featuring pork, lard, and lacquer glaze, perfect for a solo dinner, and satvik friendly. This recipe combines the richness of pork with the brightness of citrus.
instructions: Heat the lard in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the pork to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the garlic and thyme to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the orange juice and honey to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the lacquer glaze to the skillet and simmer for 1 minute.
Return the pork to the skillet and cook until coated in the glaze.
Season the pork with salt and black pepper.
Serve the pork hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
